title: dryopteris squamigera
intro: Dryopteris squamigera, commonly known as the scaly male fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce swelling and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris squamigera include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
